title: fix(app-shell): never ask for an object or record the boot does not serve
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x5PmFp4yrXd6JSvCzEvkTJ2)_

Fixes #32166

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 无需操作。等 ui 席位 3 做契约复审后按普通队列落地(只改 `ui/packages/app-shell`,非受管路径)。
问题:默认启动的控制台会请求服务端不提供的对象和记录,每次加载都在错误日志里留下 404,掩盖真正的故障。
修了三处:系统概览不再按名字探测云端专属对象 `sys_package_installation`;用户记录页不再给 API 关闭的 `sys_user_device` 拉相关列表;在记录页删除记录后不再回读这条已删除的记录(原来连发 3 个 404)。
不变:对象或记录确实存在时,小组件、相关列表、编辑后刷新都和以前一样。
未修:Studio「界面」里默认视图尚未创建时的 `/layers` 404。现有测试把它钉为设计如此(引用 objectstack#22397 的裁定 (a)),要改得先由席位裁定,已在下方说明。
本地实测:修复前 5 个 404,修复后 0 个。

## Step 0 — do the two objects belong in the stock boot?

No. Neither half is a missing server registration.

- **`sys_package_installation` is cloud-only by design.** `packages/platform-objects` `system.datasets.ts` says so ("`sys_package_installation` is cloud-only"), and the System Overview widget `widget_packages_installed` declares `requiresObject: 'sys_package_installation'` so that a single-environment runtime hides it. The 404 was the console's own presence probe: `readDashboardWidgetObjects` asked each widget object by name (`GET /meta/object/<name>`), so an absent object answered 404 on every open.
- **`sys_user_device` IS registered on the stock boot** (`@objectstack/service-messaging`, `user-device.object.ts`), and it is deliberately `enable: { apiEnabled: false, apiMethods: [] }` (the credential-table precedent). The served definition carries that block (`GET /meta/object/sys_user_device` → `enable.apiEnabled: false`, measured below). A user's record page derived a related list from its `user_id` lookup and probed `GET /data/sys_user_device` → `404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED`.

So the console must only ask for what the boot serves. No server code and nothing in `packages/spec` is touched.

## What changes

All in `@object-ui/app-shell`:

1. **Dashboard widget presence asks one `?names=` read** (`appObjectScope.ts`, `readDashboardWidgetObjects`). It now uses the provider's batched names scope (`batch: true`, `views: false`, objectstack#29444): one `GET /meta/object?names=a,b`, whose list door answers an unregistered name by leaving it out, never a 404. `readDashboardObjectScope` adds a widget's name to the route's by-name scope only once that presence read has answered it served. So an absent object is never asked by name, and a served one is still read for the route as before. `DashboardView` drops the now-unused `app` argument.
2. **No related list for a child the data API does not expose** (`deriveRelatedLists.ts`). A child object declaring `enable.apiEnabled: false` yields no record-page list (no panel, no row read, no count probe). Studio's authoring surface (`includeHidden`) still lists the relationship, flagged `isHidden`, the way it lists a `relatedList: false` one.
3. **The record page never re-reads a record it just deleted** (`RecordDetailView.tsx`). The delete's mutation event invalidated the record on the bus in the same dispatch that the page's `navigate` started from. React Router v7 runs navigation as a transition, so the page re-rendered first and re-read the record page payload, field access and approval lock, each answered 404, before leaving. The page now catches the delete event for its own record in that same dispatch. It holds the record's invalidation nonce at its last committed value, so none of the record's reads re-runs, and it draws the existing "Record not found" state instead of the body, so the body's readers unmount. Any other write to the record still re-reads it in place.

## Repro reading: before and after

Real boot, measured 2026-11-10 in this worktree: `examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4373`, with the Console Vite dev server from `ui/apps/console` (`DEV_PROXY_TARGET` set to that port). A Playwright walk signed in as the seeded admin and recorded every `/api/` response with status ≥ 400 or naming either object. **Before** = `origin/main` `8523ef9a` sources for the changed files; **after** = this branch.

| Step | Before (`main`) | After (branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Setup → System Overview | `404 GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_package_installation` | `200 GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=sys_package_installation`; Total Users tile drawn, Packages Installed tile hidden (as before) |
| `sys_user` record (drawer, `?recordId=`) | `404 GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_device?top=1&select=id&filter=["user_id","=",…]` | no 4xx; same tabs |
| Delete a `showcase_account` from its record page | `404 POST …/showcase_account/<id>/page`, `404 GET …/<id>/field-access`, `404 GET /api/v1/approvals/records/showcase_account/<id>/lock` | no 4xx; record deleted (`GET` → 404), page on the list |

Server answers behind the reading (same boot, signed-in curl):

```
GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_package_installation          -> 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=sys_package_installation,sys_user -> 200, items: [sys_user]
GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_user_device                   -> 200, enable.apiEnabled: false (also on the whole list)
GET /api/v1/data/sys_user_device?$top=1                   -> 404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED
```

On the full record page route the `sys_user` page read the package scope, which does not hold `sys_user_device`, so no probe fired there; the drawer reads the whole registry and is where the 404 reproduced.

## Tests (each new pin red on `main`, green here)

- `AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784.test.tsx` (b) is **rewritten**. It used to assert `object/cloud_only` was read by name, which is the defect this card files. It now pins: one `object?names=crm_case,cloud_only` read, no `object/cloud_only` read, the absent widget left out, and the served widget (`cases`) shown with `object/crm_case` still read. The client double's `getItems` now honours `names` the way the list door does.
- `deriveRelatedLists.test.ts`: an `apiEnabled: false` child derives no list; `apiEnabled: true` and no `enable` block keep theirs (preservation); `includeHidden` lists it flagged hidden.
- `RecordDetailView.relatedListFilter-4664.test.tsx` (new top-level describe, real `RecordDetailView`): no `find` of the `apiEnabled: false` child at all, while the exposed sibling's row query and count probe still run and its row renders.
- `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001.test.tsx` (new top-level describe, driven through the header's More actions → Delete → confirm, with an emitting data source bridged onto the bus as the console bridges it): no re-read of the deleted record after confirming; CONTROL, an `update` event for the record still re-reads it in place.

Red on `main`: 5 of the new or rewritten cases fail with the changed source files restored from `origin/main`; all pass on this branch.

## Not done here: Studio Interfaces default-view `/layers` (reported to the seat)

`useObjectListViewDraft` (`ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`) still asks `GET /meta/view/<object>.default/layers` for a default list view that exists nowhere yet, and gets a 404. I did not change it. `ObjectListViewInspector.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx` pins exactly that read as intended. Its header says the 404 is kept by the framework by design (objectstack#22397, answer (a)), that `MetadataClient.layered()` reads it as "not created yet", and that the object's merged `listViews` is deliberately **not** taken as proof the view was never saved (the 11823 pillar suite serves a default view its object definition does not list). Skipping the read would mean overturning that pin and its reasoning, which is a seat ruling, not a call to make inside this card.

## Acceptance notes

- `readDashboardWidgetObjects` no longer takes `app`. It is package-internal to `app-shell` (two callers, both updated).
- Under the draft preview the provider has no `?names=` filter, so the batched read falls back to a by-name read per name, as the nav gate's does (unchanged provider behaviour).
- A record deleted by another surface while its record page is open (for example a split pane's list) now shows "Record not found" at once instead of after a re-read that answered 404. That is the same end state, with no request.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
